words.en: Specialist knowledge refers to expert understanding or skill in a particular subject or field, often acquired through extensive study or experience.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: Consumers buy food and clothes every week.
words.ex_cn: 消费者每周购买食物和衣服。
words.en: People who buy goods or services for their own use.

words.ex: Each individuals has unique thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 每个个体都有独特的想法。
words.en: Individuals are single human beings as distinct from a group, class, or family.

words.tr: phrase. 非法利润；违法所得
words.ex: He was fined for making illegal profits.
words.ex_cn: 他因获得非法利润而被罚款。
words.en: Profits obtained through activities that are against the law.

words.ex: He has been living in London for one and a half years.
words.ex_cn: 他已经在伦敦住了一年半。
words.en: A period of time equal to eighteen months.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr:
adj. 每月的；每月一次的；
n. 月刊；
adv. 每月一次；每个月；
words.ex: He pays his rent monthly.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付房租。
words.en: Monthly means happening or done once a month or every month.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.tr: phrase. 城市花园；城市中的公共绿地或园林
words.ex: The people grow vegetables in city gardens.
words.ex_cn: 人们在城市花园里种蔬菜。
words.en: Publicly accessible green spaces within a city, designed for recreation and aesthetic enjoyment.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: He has about 2000 books in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他房间里有大约2000本书。
words.en: Approximately two thousand in number or quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍（供学生住宿的房屋或建筑群）
words.ex: The students live in the halls of residence near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在校园附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: Halls of residence are buildings where students live, typically provided by a university or college.

words.ex: The workers sleep in simple living quarters.
words.ex_cn: 工人们住在简单的住所里。
words.en: A place where people live, especially when provided for them by an organization or as part of their job.

words.ex: The hotel has many clean rooms.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有许多干净的房间。
words.en: Rooms refer to the spaces within a building that are separated by walls, floors, and ceilings, used for living, working, or storage.

words.ex: The school held the concert in the halls.
words.ex_cn: 学校在礼堂举行了音乐会。
words.en: A large room or building used for public gatherings, concerts, or other events.

words.ex: Many people go to theatres to watch plays.
words.ex_cn: 许多人去剧院看戏剧。
words.en: Theatres are buildings or outdoor areas where plays and other dramatic performances are given.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.tr: phrase. 职员；办公室工作人员
words.ex: The office staff answers phone calls every day.
words.ex_cn: 办公室职员每天接听电话。
words.en: The people who work in an office, performing various administrative and clerical tasks.

words.ex: The students are reading books in the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在图书馆里读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university, college, or school.

words.ex: He will call you on 10 December.
words.ex_cn: 他将在12月10日给你打电话。
words.en: The tenth day of the twelfth month in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.ex: He bought 7 set of dictionaries for his students.
words.ex_cn: 他为学生们买了七套词典。
words.en: A collection of seven distinct dictionaries, often used for comprehensive reference or study.

words.ex: He found old music tapes in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在抽屉里找到了旧的音乐磁带。
words.en: Tapes are long, narrow strips of material, such as plastic, that are used for recording sounds or images or for fastening things together.

words.tr: phrase. 最近的车站；最近的站点
words.ex: The nearest station is five minutes away.
words.ex_cn: 最近的车站离这里五分钟路程。
words.en: The closest or most convenient station for boarding or alighting from trains, buses, or other forms of public transport.

words.ex: He loves learning local history in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢了解自己小镇的本地历史。
words.en: Local history refers to the historical study of a particular community, area, or region, often focusing on the people, events, and developments that have shaped its identity over time.

words.tr: phrase. 步行俱乐部；徒步社团
words.ex: He joins a walking club every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期天都参加一个步行俱乐部。
words.en: A group or organization that organizes walks for its members, often for exercise, socializing, or exploring.

words.ex: He bought 20 balloons for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了20个气球。
words.en: Twenty individual balloons, typically inflated and used for decoration or celebration.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.tr: n. 岩盐晶体；指天然形成的氯化钠结晶，常用于融雪或作为粗盐调味
words.ex: The sun dried the seawater and left rock salt crystals on the shore.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒干了海水，在岸边留下了岩盐晶体。
words.en: Natural crystals of sodium chloride, often large and used for seasoning or industrial purposes.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr: phrase. 嗅觉；闻气味的能力
words.ex: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
words.ex_cn: 狗有很强的嗅觉。
words.en: The ability to perceive odors or scents.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: There are 745 markets in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有745个市场。
words.en: Places or systems where goods and services are bought and sold.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: phrase. 攀登塔楼；爬上高塔
words.ex: The boys climb the tower every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩每个星期天都爬塔。
words.en: To ascend a tower, either literally or figuratively to achieve a goal.

words.tr: phrase. 观看风景；欣赏景色
words.ex: We see the view from the top of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 我们从山顶看到景色。
words.en: To observe a landscape or scene from a high or elevated position.

words.tr: phrase. 收集数据；采集信息

words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的科学项目收集数据。
words.en: The process of gathering information or facts systematically for analysis or reference.

words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的科学项目收集数据。
words.en: Collecting information or facts systematically for analysis or study.

words.tr: phrase. 数据收集；资料采集
words.ex: The teacher uses data collection to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用数据收集来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of gathering information or data from various sources for analysis or processing.

words.tr: phrase. 导览；有导游带领的参观旅行
words.ex: They took guided tours of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a visit to a place of interest with a guide who provides information about the place.

words.ex: He has more than 12 books on math.
words.ex_cn: 他有十二本以上的数学书。
words.en: A quantity exceeding twelve units.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.tr: phrase. 二月十三日（日期表达）
words.ex: My birthday is on the 13th of February.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日是2月13日。
words.en: The date February 13th, often associated with Valentine's Day preparations.

words.tr: phrase. 伦敦塔（英国伦敦一座历史悠久的城堡，曾用作皇宫、监狱和宝库）
words.ex: The tourists visited the Tower of London.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了伦敦塔。
words.en: The Tower of London is a historic castle on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. It was founded towards the end of 1066 as part of the Norman Conquest of England. The White Tower, which gives the entire castle its name, was built by William the Conqueror in 1078 and was a resented symbol of oppression, inflicted upon London by the new ruling elite.

words.ex: He lives in Bristol.
words.ex_cn: 他住在布里斯托尔。
words.en: Bristol is a city in the southwest of England, known for its historic harbor and vibrant cultural scene.

words.ex: We visited the American Museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了美国博物馆。
words.en: An institution dedicated to preserving and exhibiting artifacts, artworks, or historical items related to the United States.

words.tr: phrase. 学生报纸；由学生编辑和出版的校园刊物
words.ex: The student newspaper writes about school events.
words.ex_cn: 学生报纸报道学校活动。
words.en: A newspaper produced by students at a school, college, or university, covering topics of interest to the student body.

words.en: A surname, often associated with individuals in media or arts.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.
